summary: Stoic's hand-painted tactical RPG series, including the standalone Factions multiplayer release and the three-part single-player Banner Saga trilogy.

entries.title: The Banner Saga: Factions
entries.definitive_edition: None currently playable through a normal official route

emulation.notes: Do not plan a normal stream playthrough unless an authorized service restoration appears.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Historical PC client; server dependency is the limiting factor.

primary.why: Factions was a standalone online multiplayer release for Windows and OS X, but its servers were shut down in 2021 and it is no longer normally playable.
primary.how_to_play: There is no current normal play route; treat this as a documented retired online game unless Stoic authorizes a restored service or offline build.

all_releases.fidelity: Historical Steam PC release; currently blocked by server shutdown.
all_releases.reason: primary: best historical capture route, but no normal current play route after shutdown.

all_releases.fidelity: Historical Mac release; currently blocked by server shutdown.
all_releases.reason: skip: no content advantage over Windows and no normal current play route after shutdown.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The issue is availability rather than fidelity: both documented releases depended on online services that were shut down.

entries.remaster_caveats: Servers were shut down and the game was removed from Steam; no official offline replacement is documented.
